exposure: Gestational week (at time of suicidal attack)
Type of drugs used in suicidal attack
outcome: Occurrence of suicidal attack (SA) during pregnancy
Characteristics of suicidal attack (method, drugs used, timing)
cohort: Pregnant women who were admitted to three different university hospital emergency departments in the same city between 2015 and 2020 after experiencing a suicidal attack.
finding: Suicidal attacks during pregnancy occur most frequently in the first trimester, with high-dose drug intake as the preferred method, and 75% of pregnant women experiencing SAs do not have a known prior psychiatric diagnosis.
